title: Remote I/O over Modbus
description: This PLC is a Modbus TCP client: its link reads the level of another PLC (a device named tank running the tank example) every 200 ms and the program raises an alarm above alarm_level. No communication code: the link is configuration.

tags.name: link_ok
tags.description: The tank PLC answers (set by the link)

tags.name: link_alarm
tags.description: The tank PLC does not answer

tags.name: remote_level
tags.description: Level read from the tank PLC's holding registers 3-4 (%)
